chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Aban ibn Uthman, from al-Fadl ibn Abd al-Malik, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Breast-feeding is valid before the two years, before he is weaned.
ai.seo_question: What is the time limit for breast-feeding to establish kinship in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This concise hadith from al-Kafi delineates the jurisprudential threshold for establishing mahram relationships through breast-feeding (radha'), specifying that nursing must occur before the child reaches two years of age and is weaned. In Shia fiqh, this narration is pivotal for defining the temporal limits of effective radha', distinguishing between nursing that creates permanent kinship and that which does not, based on the consensus of the Imams regarding the weaning period.
